collections.name: Quran
collections.description: The central religious text of Islam, consisting of 114 chapters (surahs).

collections.name: Sahih al-Bukhari
collections.description: One of the Kutub al-Sittah (six major hadith collections) of Sunni Islam, compiled by Imam Bukhari.

collections.name: Sahih Muslim
collections.description: The second most authentic hadith collection in Sunni Islam, compiled by Imam Muslim.

collections.name: Jami' at-Tirmidhi
collections.description: A major collection of hadith containing legal rulings and moral guidelines, compiled by Imam al-Tirmidhi.

collections.name: Sunan Abu Dawud
collections.description: One of the six major collections of hadith, focusing primarily on legal traditions (ahkam).

collections.name: Sunan an-Nasa'i
collections.description: A collection of hadith with a strong focus on legal aspects and jurisprudence, compiled by Imam an-Nasa'i.

collections.name: Sunan Ibn Majah
collections.description: One of the six major collections of hadith, compiled by Imam Ibn Majah.
